summary: Frontend-only verification of the Adore master update via Playwright on the public preview URL. All 13 requested items verified. HIGH-priority checkout fix CONFIRMED WORKING: after adding RAIN DROP BRANCH CHANDELIER to the cart, the 'Secure Checkout' control is a <button data-testid='checkout-cta'>, logs "Shopify checkoutUrl: https://adore.lighting/cart/c/hWNGFJ..." and the click navigates the main frame to that Shopify-hosted cart/checkout URL (store primary domain of v1hj1w-3k.myshopify.com) — never to /checkout on adore-lights.preview.emergentagent.com. Hero (4 slides from /hero/slide1-4.jpg, 200s, 5s rotation, no dots), announcement sync across all 4 slides and default on /about, /kits (3 kits, 6 items each, zero prices/₹), home kits teaser (no ₹245000), new categories kids-lights & mirror-lights ('Coming soon' empty state), outdoor subs with ?sub= params, Shopify counts (chandeliers 3, double-height-chandeliers 6, wall 1), /api/upload + /api/uploads 404, /adore-admin loads. No console/page errors on any tested route.

issues: Refine 'Price (₹)' min/max filter and the sort dropdown render even when the collection has 0 products — could be hidden in the empty state
Sort control appears to be a native <select> rather than the shadcn Select used elsewhere (cosmetic inconsistency)

critical_code_review_comments: Cart.handleCheckout correctly guards on falsy checkoutUrl and shows 'Preparing checkout…' instead of rendering a dead button — good.

Legacy /checkout page redirects to Shopify checkoutUrl and falls back to /cart when the cart is empty; no navigate('/checkout') remains in the codebase (only NewsletterPopup HIDDEN_ROUTES references the string, which is harmless).
Optional: checkoutUrl host is the store's primary domain (adore.lighting) rather than *.myshopify.com — expected Shopify behaviour, no action needed.
seed_data_creation: One Shopify cart line created during checkout test (RAIN DROP BRANCH CHANDELIER x1); ephemeral Shopify cart, no app data written.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Category slug for double-height is /shop/double-height-chandeliers (not /shop/double-height). Shopify products currently return ₹0 prices and some blank images — known store-side data issue, ignore. Checkout redirect lands on https://adore.lighting/cart/c/... — verify with page.on('framenavigated') plus the 'Shopify checkoutUrl:' console log; abort routes to the shopify host to avoid leaving the app.
rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable — previously reported /checkout 404 is resolved; Cart now assigns window.location.href = checkoutUrl returned by the Shopify Storefront cartCreate mutation.
